proposals.note: RZZ-dominant block (12 RZZ + 12 single-qubit rotations) directly generates Z_iZ_j correlations matching all 21 diagonal readout observables. Structure: RX(tied) → NN-RZZ(tied) → RY(tied) → NNN-RZZ(tied) on a 6-ring. Four tied parameters enforce translational (C6) symmetry across sites, reducing overfitting while the two entangling layers (distance-1 and distance-2 pairs) span all 15 pairwise correlations. Compared to c0004 (5 params, mixed CNOT/CRX/CRY/CRZ/CZ), this trades gate-type diversity for stronger structural regularization via the 6-cycle hypothesis and direct RZZ-to-observable alignment. With 2 layers × 2 repeats the block is applied 4×, giving 16 effective RZZ applications to build rich multi-site Z correlations.

proposals.note: Dropped hypothesis (prior equivariance and label-preservation both failed). Block uses 24 gates / 4 tied params: RY ring → RZZ nearest-neighbor ring → RX ring → RZZ long-range cross-ring. The two RZZ layers give every Z_iZ_j pair at least one entangling path, while the alternating RY/RX rotations ensure single-qubit Z_i expectations are sensitive to the re-uploaded features. Low parameter count reduces overfitting risk on a 2-target regression.

proposals.note: Cyclically-symmetric block: uniform RX(t1) and RY(t2) on all 6 qubits, then RZZ(t3) on the 6 nearest-neighbor ring pairs and RZZ(t4) on the 6 next-nearest ring pairs. 24 gates, 4 params. The Z6 cyclic relabeling (0->1->2->3->4->5->0) permutes the ring and next-nearest pair sets onto themselves, so the block is exactly invariant under this generator. This mirrors the topology of the 21 diagonal observables (Z_i and Z_iZ_j), ensuring the trainable linear readout can exploit the full symmetry-reduced feature space. Matches the top-scoring c0005 structure but now carries an explicit, verifiable invariance hypothesis so the verifier can confirm the symmetry and prune redundant observables.

proposals.note: Proven RX/RY/RZZ template (24 gates, 4 tied params) matching best prior performers c0005/c0007. RZZ split into cycle-adjacent pairs (p2) and skip-1 pairs (p3) for richer entanglement structure. Hypothesis set to null after prior verifier showed both equivariance failure and 74.6% label-preservation violation, confirming the task targets are not invariant under any simple site relabeling. Focusing on raw expressivity of the block within the 24-gate budget.

proposals.note: Cyclic-shift-symmetric block: 6 RX + 6 RY (all tied to single params) + 12 RZZ split into nearest-neighbour ring (6 pairs, param rzz_nn) and next-nearest-neighbour ring (6 pairs, param rzz_nnn). 4 trainable params, 24 gates. The cyclic generator (0→1→2→3→4→5→0) maps each RZZ pair to the next pair in its ring and leaves all single-qubit rotations unchanged, so the block is invariant under the full C6 cyclic group. This matches the top-performing c0005 structure while making the symmetry explicit for verifier feedback.

proposals.note: Dropped the previously-claimed order-6 relabeling hypothesis after verifier showed both channel residual ~0.33 (block does not realize the invariance) and label-preservation violated on 75% of training rows (targets are not invariant under that permutation). Retained the proven RX/RY/RZZ architecture (24 gates, 4 tied params) matching the lowest-risk prior c0005. Structure: 6 RX + 6 RY single-qubit rotations with 4-way parameter tying (period-4 pattern across sites), followed by 12 RZZ entanglers covering the 6-cycle ring and the 6 skip-1 chords (all pairs except the 3 diametrically opposite ones). Parameter sharing p0-p3 across the ring and chord layers creates a periodic coupling motif that the feature map re-encodes each layer. No hypothesis claimed to avoid equivariance-check failures.

proposals.note: Ring-topology RZZ entanglement (two layers of 6 nearest-neighbor couplings) sandwiched between uniform RX and RY rotations. All single-qubit rotations share a single tied parameter each, and each RZZ layer uses one tied parameter, yielding 4 trainable angles total. The cyclic shift (0→1→2→3→4→5→0) is a manifest symmetry of the block because every gate maps to another gate of the same type and parameter under the relabeling. This mirrors the best-scoring prior (c0005, dev risk 0.0045) while now supplying an explicit hypothesis for verifier feedback. The ring topology matches the 6-site experimental geometry and the 21 diagonal observables (Z_i, Z_iZ_j) readout naturally captures nearest-neighbor correlations produced by the RZZ layers.

proposals.note: Reverting to the proven RX/RY/RZZ 24-gate 4-param template (best dev-risk family). Dropped the failed relabeling hypothesis since the verifier confirmed both equivariance and label-preservation violations (74.6% label discrepancy). Ring RZZ (nearest-neighbor) and chord RZZ (next-nearest-neighbor) provide two independent entanglement scales. Tied parameters keep the block low-dimensional so the 2-layer x 2-repeat re-uploading structure can still express site-dependent features via the fixed feature map angles.
